property.name: title
property.label: Alert Title
property.description: Title of the popup while a maintenance is in progress.

property.name: reminderTitle
property.label: Reminder Title
property.description: Title of the popup when maintenances are upcoming but none is in progress yet.

property.name: currentAppContext
property.label: Current App Context
property.description: The Applicable Apps value for this page. Maintenances for this app and for System are shown; leave blank to show System maintenances only.

property.name: alertStyle
property.label: Alert Style
property.description: How alerts that can be dismissed are shown: a dialog over the page, or a banner in the component's place on the page. Locks always use a dialog.

property.name: exitAppDeveloperName
property.label: Exit App Developer Name
property.description: Developer name of the app users can navigate to when this app is locked. The button is hidden if no app with this name is found. Not used on Experience Cloud sites.
